text:
deploy-bot: Starting regional rollout v2.14.0 (tag: release/v2.14.0, commit: d4f7b9a) to production. Environments: prod. Regions: US/EU/APAC. Canary: 5% US for 10m, then 25% US/EU, then full. Change window: 02:00-05:00 UTC. Release notes: minor latency optimizations + routing fallback.

carys: ack. i'll watch logs and metrics in the console. starting smoke checks now.

mike: pinned runtime image to `redwood-runtime:2026-03-15` in the manifest per rollout playbook. will keep canary config for 30m if anything flakey shows up.

sangeeta: added extra tracing for kvcache hits on the canary traffic. dashboards linked: https://console/redwood/boards/kvcache-canary

observability-bot: Alert subscription created for latency p50/p95 and error rate > 1%. Notifying #eng-oncall.

reuben: quick note — APAC has scheduled maintenance at 03:30 UTC on the underlying infra. suggest we delay APAC step by 1h to avoid noise.

ivan: agreed with reuben. let's keep APAC paused until we can confirm infra status. proceed US canary + EU 25% while APAC is held.

deploy-bot: Update: US canary started (5% traffic) — rolling out to 4 instances. tag: release/v2.14.0, commit d4f7b9a.

carys: running end-to-end tests against canary. logs showing initial token latency down ~8%. no errors so far.

observability-bot: Metric snapshot @1769998920: US p95=210ms, p50=38ms, errors=0.4%. KV cache hit rate +7%.

mike: i'm keeping the override for model-variants lower so we don't hit expensive endpoints during canary. Also setting rollback trigger if errors >1% sustained for 5m.

deploy-bot: Progress: US canary -> healthy. Promoting to US/EU 25% now. APAC remains paused by request.

sangeeta: EU traffic shows slight uptick in request queueing on one node, investigating.

ic: found a GC spike on eu-node-3 around 1769998950. not associated with the rollout change, likely infra fluke.

carys: given that, i'm going to proceed with caution — keep EU at 25% for another 20m before full promotion. marking rollout as paused for APAC and slow-promote for EU.

deploy-bot: Checkpoint: US=rolled (5->100%), EU=25% (holding), APAC=paused. change_window_reminder: 02:00-05:00 UTC.

reuben: logged a ticket with infra for APAC maintenance overlap: INFRA-6218. once cleared we'll schedule APAC step.

mike: decided: no pin rollback yet. if EU stays stable we'll finish tonight. if any error spike >1% for 5m we auto-rollback to tag release/v2.13.9.

observability-bot: Final note in thread: set on-call rotation for next 60m. If APAC cleared, request a manual resume comment in this thread.

carys: thanks all — i'll keep monitoring and will post another update once EU holds for the 20m window or if anything pops. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Rollout checkpoint recorded at 1769998975. Logs: /deploy/logs/1769998888-v2.14.0.checkpoint
